content: Isreelitay doorintto
Taanii Kiristtoosar maaqqii turo odiza, worddotooya. Geeshsha Ayyanay kaalithiza ta kahay taanii worddotoozana taas markkattiza.
Ta wozinar Isra7eelitayis gaame qofarannee duuxoowa un7ara qamma gallas ta qoppiza.
Taanii, taas ashor dabo maaqqeez ta ishitay gishos Kiristtoosapp shaakinttii Xooss baadith gancce yezeezako dosizazin.

Unttii Isra7eelita, Xoossay unttan fa na7ita udeeza, fa bonchcha unttis qoncce odeeza. Unttar caaqqeeza; higge unttis inggeeza. U Xoossa goynnod tuma oga beezeeza; Xoossay ufayis qaala unttis inggeeza.
U yeletithayid mayzitay kochch; ma Kiristtoosa ashor kochche maaqqii ye7eeza. Ubbaypp aadho maaqqeez Xoossay medhinas galatintto. Amin7e!
Maaqqozin, Xoossa qaalay polinttekka atteeza guus baaya. Isra7eelepp yelintteez as ubbitay Isra7eele baaya.
Ma Afraame zare ubbitay Afraame na7ita baaya. Xoossay Afraames, «Ne sheeshay Isaaqa baggar xeeginttoda» yeegeeza.
Yeya guussay ashor yelintteez na7itay ubbitay Xooss na7ita baaya. Zin tuma Isra7eele na7itay Xoossay geleez qaalay garkk yelintteez na7ita.
Inggoda gi geleez qaalay, «Taanii layth wode yhannode ye7oda; Saarakka dhiirathi na7a yeloda» yeegintteezanno.
Yey aadda baazin Irbiqa ma pettii nu ada Isaaqar aqi wodexeez wode.
Mentte na7itay yelinttodaypp woy iita woy lo77o udekkazin xeegizaypp attin oosopp baazin dooro Xooss qofay miinggoday garkke
«Bayray geedayis haarinttoda» yeegii Goday iis odeeza.
Yeykka Geeshsha Maxaafayid, «Yayqqooba dosii, Eesawe ta ixxeeza» ginttinttii xaafintteeza.
Yeezin, nuunii waagodee? Xoossay ase asapp qurinee? Xoossii quriza godayiss nu danda7ooya!
Goday Museko,

content.text: Yikkee, Xooss dooro as shener woy as oosor baazin e maarotithayira.

content: Geesha Maxaafayid, Gibxxe kaatayiko, «Taanii, ta wolqqa neell beezodaysinnee ta sunthay alame ubbayil erinttod garkk yeyis nena kawutiseeza» ginttinttii xaafintteeza.
Yikkee, Xoossay maarodayis koyizana maariza; wozina muumisodayis koyizay wozina muumisiza.
Xooss kachchinnee maarotith
Yinttipp pettay, «Yeezin, Xoossay as abis boree? Xooss ixxizay oonoo?» yeegii oycodayis danda7iza.
Zin neno aso, Xoossar palamodayis ne oonoo? Ooso fana ootheezayiko, «Tana yhay garkk udii abis ootheenee?» gi oycodayis danda7inee?
Woy urqqa medhdheezay pettii urqqapp petta bonchcho miishe, yhankka ma tooshe miishe udii medhdhodayis mawute baasannee?
Xoossay fa seera beezodayisinnee fa wolqqa ersodayis koy dhabos giigsseez seera miishshita gaame garzhor danda7eezako ab eree?
E yeya ootheezay damma bonchos giigiseez, fa dooreez na7itayis fa bonchcha ersodayisii.
Ayihude maaqqin, woy Ayihude baa as ubbita Xoossii dooreeza.
Nabe Hosa7e maxaafay gancce,

content.text: Unttii ‹Ta woya baaya› ginttinttii xeegintteez aqayid,

content.text: Goday biitta ubbayil afa ellis murttii ukker yhaya udoda.»

Yeezin, nu waagodee? Xillotith koyibe7ekka Ayihude baa asay ammanor xillotithi denggeeza.
Zin xillotithayiko helthiz higge yeza Isreele asay xillotithi denggekkaya.
Abis denggekkasa? Unttii xillotith ammanor baazin oosor ekkodayis kozheez gishos. Yey gishos, unttii, «Dhubbiza shuchchar» dhubintteeza.
